title: Tamil Nadu Safe and Ethical Artificial Intelligence Policy 2020
issuing_body: Information Technology Department, Government of Tamil Nadu (prepared by Commissionerate of e-Governance and TNeGA)

timeline.event: Policy issued by the IT Department (press reports place release in September 2020; exact date unverified)
Policy Note 2026-27 of the renamed AI, IT and Digital Services department reaffirms TAM-DEF/DEEP-MAX assessment of government AI systems

summary: First Indian state AI policy. Sets an evaluation framework (TAM-DEF) and scorecard (DEEP-MAX) that state agencies must apply before procuring or deploying AI systems, with a Chief Secretary-led monitoring committee.
key_provisions: Applies to all authorities, PSUs, boards, cooperatives, societies, partnerships and JVs owned, controlled or aided by the Government of Tamil Nadu
Six-dimensional TAM-DEF framework: Transparency & Audit, Accountability & Legal issues, Misuse protection, Digital divide & Data deficit, Ethics, Fairness & Equity

Seven-parameter DEEP-MAX scorecard (Diversity, Equity, Ethics, Privacy & data protection, Misuse protection, Audit & transparency, digital divide/data deficit); binary 0/1 scoring to start, re-scoring suggested at most every 6 months

Procurement guideline: departments must consult the Centre of Excellence in Emerging Technologies (CEET) at TNeGA before any AI procurement and ensure a satisfactory DEEP-MAX score; government may reject or recall non-compliant systems
Scores to be recorded on an 'AI Certification, Transparency & Scorecard' (ACTS) blockchain to be built by TNeGA on the Nambikkai Inaiyam backbone
Oversight by a Safe & Ethical AI Monitoring Committee headed by the Chief Secretary with Law Department and academic experts
Commits to AI curriculum updates in schools/colleges, an AI regulatory sandbox, open data access and an AI for Governance Research Centre
confidence_note: Full policy text read (mirrored PDF); official State Planning Commission page confirms department and year. GO number and exact release date not located; official tn.gov.in PDF link not retrieved.
